abstract: Fifteen patients with advanced testicular germ cell tumor were treated by VAB-6 chemotherapy after radical orchiectomy. CR was achieved in two (13.3%) and PR in nine (60.0%). The one, three and five year survival rates were 92.2, 64.2 and 51.4%, respectively. Nine patients (60.0%) remain with no evidence of disease (NED) after combined therapy (chemotherapy and surgery) with a median follow up of 4.3 months. We performed resection of the residual tumors and examined histologically. Out of 11 cases, four (36.3%) were with necrosis/fibrosis, two (18.2%) teratoma and five (45.5%) cancer. All of the six cases with non-cancerous tissues remain in NED. However, only two of the five cases with cancerous tissues remain in NED. We studied the NED rate based on four prognostic factors, (1) bulky abdominal diseases, (2) advanced lung diseases, (3) other metasteses, and (4) choriocarcinoma. In our analysis, advanced lung diseases and choriocarcinoma were poor prognostic factors. We should treat these poor prognostic cases initially with VP-16, ifosfamide, high doses cisplatin etc, which were used as salvaged drugs.
abstract_ja: 根治的精巣摘除術後の進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者15例に対し、VAB-6化学療法を施行した。CRは2例(13.3%)、PRは9例(60.0%)であった。1年、3年、5年生存率はそれぞれ92.2%、64.2%、51.4%であった。中央値4.3か月のフォローアップ時点で、化学療法と手術の併用療法後に9例(60.0%)が無病(NED)の状態であった。残存腫瘍を切除し組織学的に検討した。11例中、壊死/線維化が4例(36.3%)、奇形腫が2例(18.2%)、癌が5例(45.5%)であった。非癌性組織のみの6例は全例NEDを維持した。一方、癌組織を含む5例のうちNEDを維持したのは2例のみであった。NED率を、(1)巨大腹部病変、(2)進行肺病変、(3)その他の転移、(4)絨毛癌の4つの予後因子で検討した。解析の結果、進行肺病変と絨毛癌が不良な予後因子であった。これらの不良な予後の症例には、初回治療としてVP-16、イホスファミド、高用量シスプラチンなどを用いるべきであり、これらは救済療法として用いられてきた薬剤である。
